notes: One shared cell geometry and manifest; pages bound texture dimensions.
2x exports are uniformly resampled from generated source resolution; they do not add new drawn detail.
Every clip uses one calibration scale; no per-frame bounding-box fitting.
Generated pose art can retain shape and colour variation; native visual acceptance is still required.
Root offsets are logical pixels external to the source frame. Apply pacing rootX once only; source walks are in place.
Directional looks are discrete targets; do not play as a spinning-body loop.
